summary: Frontend-only regression completed for Home quick actions, Timeline navigation/search/filters, Insights, wallet routing, light mode, responsive overflow, and mock-only behavior. One requested mobile navigation defect remains: Cartões is covered by the centered FAB and cannot be clicked.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px mobile width, the Cartões nav item overlaps the FAB (Cards box x=187..229, FAB x=169..221) and Playwright reports the FAB intercepting pointer events, so Cartões cannot be opened normally.

action_items: Adjust mobile BottomNavigation spacing/layout so Cartões is fully outside the FAB hit area and verify normal click navigation to /cards.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile nth-child margin adjustments do not reserve enough horizontal space around the centered FAB; the resulting overlap blocks the Cartões link.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Timeline, Insights, and quick-entry interactions used local MOCKS only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL https://fox-ui-core.preview.emergentagent.com tested. Desktop and mobile Home/Timeline navigation, four quick-action modals, Timeline metadata/search/all five filters, Insights cards/action/close, Planning shortcut, wallet to Accounts, light-mode color change, no horizontal overflow, and no API/Supabase writes passed. Re-test mobile nav-cartões after layout fix; current click is intercepted by fab-add-button.
rca of the issue: BottomNavigation keeps the FAB centered with absolute positioning while the mobile nav links remain distributed across the full row. The Cartões item occupies the FAB's horizontal hit area despite nth-child margins, and the FAB is rendered above it, causing pointer-event interception.
